Gelato Strain by Originals: Sweet, Doughy Terps and A Heavy Euphoria

Part Sunset Sherbert, part Thin Mint Girl Scout Cookies, the Gelato strain is a celebrated cultivar among cannabis connoisseurs. Gelato is a mid-to-high THC, typically balanced hybrid. The strain has a sweet, doughy, and citrusy taste. Originals crafts one of the purest and most potent cuts of Gelato you can find in California.

Jack Herer Strain by Originals: Robust Fruity Flavors And Pure Sativa Power

Jack Herer is a sativa-dominant strain named after the famous hemp activist and author of The Emperor Wears No Clothes. Part Northern Lights #5, part Shiva Skunk, and part Haze, this cultivar was developed in Amsterdam in the 1990s. Originals is known for crafting one of the most potent cuts of this legendary strain.
Jeeter Brand Guide: Extremely Flavorful And Potent Infused Pre-Rolls, Blunts, and Vapes at Originals LA

Jeeter is arguably the most popular creator of infused pre-rolls (and more recently vapes) in California. From their expansive genetics library to their master infusion process, Jeeter knows just how to craft a premium infused pre-roll. Jeeters use their top-shelf indoor-grown flower alongside potent distillate oil and premium kief. This winning combination brings you a long-lasting burn, tremendous flavor, and high THC percentages.
